public_rationale: The records establish substantial earlier work on visual neural networks, commonsense reasoning, world models, and limitations of language-only learning. They support the narrower point that these subjects have histories involving other researchers. They do not complete the priority comparison for all five ideas, particularly LeCun's earliest LLM and scaling arguments. The blanket conclusion therefore remains unresolved.
limitations: A predecessor is not proof that every later contribution lacks originality.
The conclusion's scope requires interpretation from the essay.
The evidence does not establish plagiarism, deliberate omission, or motives.

our_interpretation: The surrounding essay identifies five subjects: convolutional neural networks, criticism of LLMs, criticism of pure scaling, commonsense and physical reasoning, and world models.
I read the concluding sentence as a historical assertion that these broad ideas have predecessors, not a denial that LeCun made any original technical contributions.
A prior related publication establishes an antecedent. Establishing that LeCun did not originate a particular argument also requires comparison with his earliest relevant work.
The target is the historical record through the post date. No single starting date is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Dated records and a priority comparison establish predecessors for all five broad ideas attributed to LeCun in the essay.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented priority comparison establishes that LeCun originated an identifiable broad idea that the essay says he did not originate. Original refinements alone do not contradict the scoped claim.
